```plato

    //==
    // # Fit quality and residuals
    //
    // The derived readings of a FitQuality and the per-sample residual of each
    // fitted shape declared in `geometry.types.plato`. A residual is the
    // distance from one sample to the fitted shape — the quantity the fit
    // minimizes — so these are the definitions an estimator's own quality record
    // must agree with, and the way a caller re-checks a fit against new samples.
    //
    // Radial residuals (circle, sphere) measure to the shape's boundary, so a
    // sample at the centre has a residual equal to the radius. Line and plane
    // residuals are unsigned perpendicular distances.

    //==
    // # Fit quality
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Root-mean-square_deviation

    // The mean square of the residuals: the square of the RMS error.
    MeanSquareError(self: FitQuality): Number
        => self.RootMeanSquareError.Square;
```
